content: Hello! Thanks for reaching out to the Neighborhood Supplies Store. How can I assist with your community fundraiser purchases today?
Hi, I placed an order for the bake sale supplies on Sunday using my debit card. I want to check if the payment went through.

Let me pull up your recent order. For reference, is this for the order under Samantha Lin at 9 Oakridge Drive, using the card ending 4421? The transaction I see was processed via Zelle on June 2nd for $183.75.
Yes, that's correct. The confirmation email came from orders@neighbstore.com, and I noticed a reference code BKS-20240602-57.
Perfect! That reference code BKS-20240602-57 matches our records. The payment via Zelle was instantly marked as received, so your order is on track.
Great. Will I need to show anything when picking up? I'm hoping to collect the items by 4pm today since the event starts soon.
No additional documents needed, just mention your name, Samantha Lin, and the order code when you arrive. Everything is set for a swift pickup at our main entrance before 4pm, as requested.
Thank you! My number is 555-0173 if there are any issues.

Thanks for confirming, Samantha. I've added your number, 555-0173, to the order notes in case we need to contact you urgently. Looking forward to seeing you this afternoon, your bake sale items will be ready for you right on time.
